He served for 46 years in the Department.en: He served for 46 years in the Department of Civil Engineering at Kunsan National University, including as professor, dedicating himself to nurturing the next generation of scholars, and was awarded the Order of Service Merit with Yellow Stripes. After retirement, he pursued photography, creating works of profound philosophy and artistry centered on water and light.
He served for 46 years in the Department.hint: An earlier version of this sentence was translated as: Il a servi pendant 46 ans au département de génie civil de l'Université nationale de Kunsan, notamment comme professeur, se consacrant à la formation des générations suivantes, et a reçu l'ordre du Mérite civil (Raies jaunes). Après sa retraite, il s'est tourné vers la photographie et a créé, autour de l'eau et de la lumière, des œuvres d'une grande profondeur philosophique et artistique.
